   112	function makeInput(opts) {
   113	  opts = opts || {};
   114	  return {
   115	    experiment: opts.experiment || makeExperiment(opts.experimentOverrides),
   116	    appliedChange: opts.appliedChange || makeAppliedChange(opts.appliedChangeOverrides),
   117	    followUp: opts.followUp || makeFollowUp(opts.followUpOverrides),
   118	    observation: opts.observation || makeObservation(opts.observationOverrides),
   119	    controlVariableObservations: (opts.controlVariableObservations !== undefined)
   120	      ? opts.controlVariableObservations
   121	      : makeControlVariableObservations(),
   122	  };
   123	}
